products.title: Hurricane - Boule Lamp Rock - Sage
products.description_html:
Hurricane Rock is a combination of industrial design and handicraft. It is inspired by the fantastic rock formation "Lords Rock" in Bohemia. Through a unique process, the colour flows into the crystal clear glass when pressed by hand.

Hurricane Rock is approx. 12 cm in height and 10 cm in diameter. Weight is approx. 1,4 kg. Use a maximum 35 mm diameter paraffin tealight. Make sure the light is centered in the lantern to avoid uneven heating of the inner walls of the lantern.

Hurricane Rock is a hand-pressed lantern. As a result of this artisanal process, small irregularities may appear within the glass—such as tiny bubbles, delicate lines, or subtle folds in the material. These are beautiful hallmarks of the handcrafted nature of the piece, endowing each Hurricane Rock with its own unique character and charm.
